control.description-key: Renders Markdown-formatted help text, scaled to the text size of the form

property.name: boundText
property.description-key: Optional: a Single Line of Text or Multiple Lines of Text column containing Markdown. Takes priority over Markdown Text when both are set. Leave unbound to use this as a static help-text component with no backing column.

property.name: markdownText
property.description-key: Static Markdown text, set at design time, used when Text Column is not bound or has no value. Supports full CommonMark + GitHub Flavored Markdown (tables, task lists, strikethrough), fenced code blocks with syntax highlighting, and GitHub-style alert callouts (e.g. a blockquote starting with [!NOTE], [!TIP], [!IMPORTANT], [!WARNING], or [!CAUTION]).

property.name: calloutTextLayout
property.description-key: Where an alert callouts body text starts relative to its icon + label. Same Line keeps the body text starting right after the label on the same line (default). New Line starts the body text on the line below the label.

value.name: SameLine
value.description-key: Body text starts on the same line as the icon + label.

value.name: NewLine
value.description-key: Body text starts on the line below the icon + label.

property.name: lineSpacing
property.description-key: Line height multiplier applied to the rendered text. Defaults to 1.55, the controls original fixed value.
